dance_findings.energy_and_amplitude: 0.0–7.8s has immediate grounded side steps, low kicks, torso/arm accents and an outward turn with visible weight transfer. Around 8.0–10.7s the amplitude drops markedly into a slow arms-out reset/near-hold, contrary to the requested continuous brisk phrase. Movement resumes for the inward approach and finish.
dance_findings.faces_and_costumes: Serega and Yulia remain recognizable against their individual sheets; serious expressions, screen sides and costumes remain stable. No extra cast or weapon appears.
dance_findings.anatomy_feet_weight: At the sampled cadence, feet remain grounded with readable push-off and landing; no obvious extra/fused limbs or gross hand/foot deformation was found. Serega's robe occasionally obscures foot detail but does not erase the motion.
dance_findings.partner_contact_support: This A1 prompt does not require a lift or physical support. The pair mirrors and answers movement without accidental collision; no physical contact is claimed.
dance_findings.choreography: The opening broad side steps, low kick-steps and outward turn are readable. The middle loses the requested continuous kick/answer and heel-toe intensity, then the pair travels inward and reaches the planned face-to-face handoff with both hands lowered.
dance_findings.camera: Single stable full-body view with a smooth lateral/push-in move, readable feet through the dance and no bars or cuts. The final push-in crops the feet only after the handoff is established.
